# Working of Counting Sort

#### Course: DSA with C++

## Working of Counting Sort

Let's consider a vector of integers.

![Unsorted Vector](data:image/png;base64,)

1. Find the largest element (max).

Here, 10 is the largest element.

![Locate the Maximum Element](data:image/png;base64,)

2. Create the counting vector to count the occurrence of each element.

Create a new vector whose size is one more than max.

We know that our max element is 10. So, we need a new vector that has 10 + 1 elements, i.e., 11 elements.

![Counting Vector](data:image/png;base64,)

Next, we'll fill up this counting vector.
